headline.label: Minds Mosaic
headline.scope: full-population questions of every scored survey

evidence_classes.pre_fieldwork: locked before the planned fieldwork start (strong evidence). Provisional until the published field dates are checked; if fieldwork actually began before the lock, the target is reclassified as before_release.
evidence_classes.before_release: locked after fieldwork may have begun but before any result was public (weaker evidence).

evidence_types.attitude: what people think or feel: approval, trust, satisfaction, sentiment, ratings, expectations
evidence_types.stated_intent: what people say they will do: vote intention, likelihood to vote, purchase, spending or saving plans
evidence_types.behaviour: what people actually did: votes cast, turnout, sales, spending, box office
